lines: Chahenge tujhe, par kabhi ruswa na karenge
couplets.en: I will love you, and never bring you shame.

lines: Saaye se bhi apne tera shikwa na karenge
couplets.en: I will speak no grievance against you, even to my own shadow.

lines: Poochhenge hawaon se, ghataon se tera haal
couplets.en: I will ask the winds and the rain clouds how you are.

lines: Milne ko tere waaste aaya na karenge
